method: OrthoHMM depth-two reconciliation with final root-HOG co-ortholog closure
hypothesis: After HMM-gated membership and phylogenetic root-HOG inference are complete, all cross-species gene pairs within a final root HOG are co-ortholog candidates. Completing those pairs should recover pairwise recall without feeding permissive relationships back into root-HOG construction.

selection_policy.validation_exposure_note: An offline all-partition pair diagnostic was run while evaluating the predefined full-closure rule. No threshold, subset, or parameter was selected from validation behavior, and no further variant was evaluated before this freeze.
selection_policy.selection_reason: The single predefined full-closure rule raised development direct pair recall from 0.570148 to 0.715097 and transitive recall from 0.705162 to 0.764921 with zero cross-RefOG pairs. Root-HOG output is byte-identical to frozen v7.

verification.integration_tests: not runnable on this host because the installed mcl rejects the repository's existing --abc option

decision: Freeze the exact implementation and spend one QfO evaluation without further parameter changes. The OrthoBench root-HOG target is already met; QfO determines whether broader co-ortholog reporting improves the six-metric mean enough to retain the rule.
